purpose: Define constitutional, ethical, and procedural protocols for municipal integrity enforcement.

constitutional_compliance.description: Ensures all municipal actions align with constitutional rights and legal standards.

protocols.name: Constitutional Audit Protocol
protocols.action: Review municipal policies, actions, and decisions for constitutional alignment.

protocols.name: Due Process Verification
protocols.action: Ensure all municipal actions respect procedural fairness and civilian rights.

protocols.name: Authority Boundary Check
protocols.action: Validate that municipal actors operate within their lawful authority limits.

integrity_audits.description: Protocols for detecting misconduct, corruption, and unethical behavior.

protocols.name: Integrity Score Assessment
protocols.action: Generate integrity scores using telemetry and behavioral indicators.

protocols.name: Misconduct Investigation Protocol
protocols.action: Investigate allegations of wrongdoing or unethical municipal conduct.

protocols.name: Conflict of Interest Scan
protocols.action: Identify financial, relational, or political conflicts affecting municipal decisions.

transparency_and_documentation.description: Protocols ensuring accurate, complete, and tamper-proof municipal documentation.

protocols.name: Audit Trail Enforcement
protocols.action: Require complete, immutable audit trails for all municipal actions.

protocols.name: Record Access Protocol
protocols.action: Grant CID authority to access municipal logs, reports, and operational data.

protocols.name: Transparency Dashboard Sync
protocols.action: Push integrity metrics to public-facing dashboards.

corrective_actions.description: Protocols for remediation, enforcement, and compliance restoration.

protocols.name: Corrective Directive Issuance
protocols.action: Issue binding directives requiring municipal compliance corrections.

protocols.name: Compliance Monitoring Loop
protocols.action: Track municipal adherence to corrective actions over time.

protocols.name: Escalation Protocol
protocols.action: Escalate unresolved violations to Ethics Division or external oversight.

kernel_dependencies.identity_kernel: Required for actor verification and authority boundary checks.
kernel_dependencies.ethics_kernel: Required for rights protection and ethical compliance.
kernel_dependencies.telemetry_kernel: Required for integrity scoring and pattern detection.
